subject: Midweek ops flashline: QBR prep, OKR check, asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Midweek ops flashline: QBR prep, OKR check, asks

Team — quick midweek pulse ahead of next week’s QBR. Short bullets (no more than 90s to read). I’ve attached the current deck and the latest cost export. Please reply with any final blockers or approvals by EOD Tuesday so we can lock slides.

Wins:
- Serving runtime: P95 latency for text-gen pipeline at 2k tokens is down from 220ms to 185ms week-over-week after kernel swap on the nv4 cluster. This keeps our latency OKR on track (+0.8% headroom).
- Redwood Optimize pilot: first 3 customers moved to recommended batching profile — projected 18% token cost reduction in week 1.
- Private onboarding: automated infra bootstraps validated for 2 EU customers (no manual network steps).

Risks / gaps:
- Model onboarding backlog: two critical review items on quantization validation (QA flagged regressions in BLEU tests). If not cleared by Wednesday, we’ll lose the Dedicated rollout milestone.
- QBR narrative: the cost slide needs sign-off — CFO asked for monthlyized unit economics, not just relative savings. I’ve included the csv export.
- Legal: final redlines on the Marketplace contract are pending (Poseidon Legal requested a data-processing addendum).

Asks (actionable):
1) Laura — can you approve the cost-slide framing (2 bullets + chart) or propose edits by Tue 3pm?
2) Jonas — prioritize the quantization repro on the nightly regression job and post a short action plan (owner, ETA) into the drive doc by EOD Wed.
3) Marissa — please confirm whether we want to highlight the Optimize pilot as a commercial win in the exec deck (one slide) — I can draft language; need decision by Tue noon.

Attachments: QBR-draft-v3.pptx (pptx), cost-trends-06-26.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
kmpark@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Midweek ops flashline: QBR prep, OKR check, asks

Kimberly — thanks for the concise update. Quick notes: 

- Quantization repro: I ran the failing workload overnight; root cause looks like a precision mismatch in the custom clamp kernel for int4. I’ll assign Priya to push a fix to the nightly and re-run the BLEU/ROUGE suite. Expect a follow-up by Tue 11:00.
- For the cost slide, I suggest we include a small table showing raw tokens processed + effective cost per 1M tokens so CFO can validate numbers quickly. I’ll generate that from the csv and drop a snapshot into the Drive link.

Also: can we add Jared from KiteCloud to the Optimize pilot slide? He’s offered a short customer quote — can use it only if we have permission.

Subject: Re: Midweek ops flashline: QBR prep, OKR check, asks

Thanks, Kim. Good progress. A couple of executive-level edits and one ask:

1) Cost slide: yes to the table Jonas suggested. Also add the topline: "Unit cost improvement driven by batching & kernel optimization: 18%" with a footnote calling out pilot scope (3 customers). Finance will want the monthlyized view.
2) Customer quote: we can include Jared’s quote but please get written permission from KiteCloud legal (copy their legal contact).
3) Ask — procurement exception: Poseidon Legal flagged the Marketplace contract clause on data residency. I need a short memo (1 paragraph) from Security that confirms the standard residency guarantees for Dedicated and Private deployments so I can push the vendor to accept the DPA. Can someone from Product Ops pull that?

If we have those three things by Tue close, I’ll approve the deck for distribution to execs on Wed morning.

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Strategy — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
